summary: Hotfixed working-tree daemon.js: declared `const gated = isTruthy(u.searchParams.get('gated'))` at the top of /search and reused it in the gated branch — the structural-rerank block at ~1713 (part of the uncommitted iterative-retrieval feature) referenced `gated` undefined, breaking /search and search_knowledge on the live daemon. Daemon restarted (new PID 81931), search verified working. NOT committed: the bug exists only in the iterative-retrieval agent's uncommitted work; the fix will ship with that feature's commit. Also retired 2 duplicate strict-autonomy-score notes (created by pre-fix record_decision crashes) via supersede_note; note-mqacbw9tv85 is canonical.

subject: Hotfix: declare gated variable in /search ungated path
description: daemon.js:1713 references undefined `gated` in the structural-rerank block, breaking /search and search_knowledge on the live daemon. Declare const gated near the top of the /search handler and restart daemon.
